description: Create an evidence-backed counterparty pack for a shipper, receiver, or both. Resolves canonical identifiers, SEC/GLEIF/USAspending/EPA identity signals, sanctions status, and public-record standing, then returns a review checklist for credit terms and load release. Name matches are candidates to verify; this is not a credit report or endorsement.

state.description: Optional 2-letter state to disambiguate either party.

name: shipper_receiver_counterparty_pack
